Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. For guard failures title and detail are the exact strings the dashboard toasts.

code.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, OVER_LIMIT, VERSION_CONFLICT

info.description: Dashboard and back-office API. Errors are application/problem+json; money is integer cents; instants are ISO-8601 UTC; business dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the business timezone.
info.title: Oasis Auto Spa API

get.summary: The synchronizer token to send as X-CSRF-Token on unsafe requests

post.summary: Accept an invite: set the email and password, activate the employee and sign in
Sign in with email and password; sets the session cookie
Revoke the current session and clear the cookie
Change the password; every other session is revoked
Request a password-reset link (always 202)
Set a new password with a reset token; revokes every session of the account

get.summary: Store-credit balance and lots of a client (expired lots leave the balance)

get.description: `q` matches first, last, full name, phone, title and role names, never email. Pay type and rate are null without team.edit; phone and email are masked without cli.contact or team.edit.

post.description: Needs team.roles as well when roles other than Crew or any exception is given. Errors: 422 "First name and mobile number are required." / "Assign at least one role.". The invite link is only echoed (`invite.link`) to a Super Admin when no channel delivered it.
post.summary: Create an employee as invited and send the invite

get.summary: One employee with schedule, exceptions and effective permissions (ETag = version)

put.description: Fields are optional; omitted ones are unchanged. Changing roles or exceptions also needs team.roles; touching a Super Admin, assigning Super or a role carrying set.billing/pay.void needs a Super Admin.

post.summary: Deactivate (revokes their sessions; the last active Super Admin cannot be deactivated)

get.summary: Per-permission { on, src, ov, limit } for one employee

post.summary: Issue a fresh 7-day invite and send it
Send the employee a password-reset link (SMS first, email fallback)
Reactivate; back to invited when they never accepted an invite

get.description: Query `channels` (comma separated: ops, payments, messages, settings, notifications; default all permitted). Resume with the `Last-Event-ID` header (or `lastEventId`). Channels the caller lacks permission for are dropped and listed in `ready.denied`.
Ledger order is `occurredAt desc, seq desc`. `canApprove` / `approveBlock` on each pending refund are evaluated for the caller (limit, self-approval).
get.summary: One invoice: items, adjustment lines, calc, ledger (newest first) and client credit

post.description: Blocked over the adjust limit (422 `OVER_LIMIT`: "Over your {limit} as {Role}. Ask Management or a Super Admin."). A discount that leaves a paid invoice overpaid creates a settlement refund (`settle`: credit by default) as a normal refund event with the refund limit and processor rules.
post.summary: Discount or surcharge before tax, in $ (cents) or % (basis points) of the items subtotal
Apply store credit to the invoice: min(usable credit, balance)

post.description: `expiry` accepts `none|d30|d90` or the design labels `No expiry|30 days|90 days`. Over the credit limit: 422 `OVER_LIMIT`.
post.summary: Issue account credit linked to the invoice (no expiry, 30 or 90 days)

post.description: The link must be HTTPS on an allowed host. `balance` expects the current balance (or `amountCents`); `deposit` needs `amountCents`. No ledger event until the sync or staff record the payment.
post.summary: Attach a Squarespace checkout or invoice link and text it to the client

post.description: Cash records a `pay`. Card records a `pay` that counts immediately with `processorState: awaiting_processor` (completed in Squarespace; label is the card brand only). `payment_link` creates a payment link and queues the SMS; no ledger event. 422 `PAY_NOTHING_TO_COLLECT` when the balance is 0.
post.summary: Collect the full balance: card, cash or a payment link
Queue the receipt by SMS (opted-in clients) and email

post.description: Pending (waiting for approval) exactly when the amount is strictly greater than the caller's refund limit; otherwise done. Errors: 422 `REFUND_EXCEEDS_CARD` (card cap), `REFUND_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE`, `ITEM_ALREADY_REFUNDED`, `PAY_AMOUNT_INVALID`.
post.summary: Refund (full, by item or custom) to the original card, store credit or cash

post.description: Needs pay.refund and a limit of at least the amount (403 `CANT_APPROVE`); the requester cannot approve their own request unless they have no limit or approvals.allow_self is on (403 `SELF_APPROVAL`). Refundable and card cap are re-validated without this request's own reservation. 409 `REFUND_NOT_PENDING`.
post.summary: Approve a pending refund
Deny a pending refund (the requester may withdraw their own)

put.summary: Set the tip (untaxed, added after tax)

post.summary: Void a cash payment or a card payment still awaiting Squarespace

post.description: Needs the permission of the original action: pay.collect for a payment, pay.refund for a refund.
post.summary: Confirm that a card payment or refund was completed in Squarespace

get.summary: The signed-in person: roles, effective permissions and limits, preferences, view-as state

post.description: Allowed only when the real person holds the locked Super Admin role, even while viewing as a lesser role (so they can always exit). Authority is then that of the viewed role alone, with no per-person exceptions; audit rows keep the real actor and record the viewed role.
post.summary: Super Admin only: evaluate the app as another role (null clears)

get.summary: Server time in the business timezone
Refunds waiting for approval, oldest first

get.description: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, RFC 4180 quoting, money as plain decimals, text cells starting with = + - @ prefixed with an apostrophe. Filename `oasis-invoices_{from}_{to}.csv`. At most 20,000 rows.
get.summary: CSV of the invoices in the range (narrowed by filter and search)

get.description: Sorted by `bizDate desc, invoiceNo desc`; keyset pagination (`nextCursor`). `filter`: all, unpaid (balance > 0), refunds (refunded or pending), adjusted, credits (credit issued or applied). `q` searches invoice id, client, vehicle and item names (case-insensitive, over the joined text like the design).
get.summary: Invoice list of a range, newest business day first
Card money waiting on Squarespace for more than 2 hours, unmatched Squarespace records, overpaid invoices

get.description: Ranges are inclusive business days ending today in the business timezone (`today`, `7d`, `30d`, `mtd`). All amounts are integer cents. Net revenue = gross + adjustments - refunds with their tax portion removed (half-up). `pendingApprovals` and `awaitingProcessor` are global, not range-filtered.
get.summary: KPIs, chart, collected-by-method, filter counts and pending approvals for a range
Roles with the permission catalog, matrix, money limits (cents) and people counts

post.summary: Add a custom role (copies Crew plus sched.edit, limits 25/25/25; default name "Shift Lead", uniquified)

delete.summary: Remove a custom role: strips it from people (anyone left with none becomes Crew) and returns the affected count

patch.summary: Rename or describe a role (not the locked Super Admin role)

put.description: Super Admin only (403 SUPER_ONLY otherwise, in addition to team.roles). Locked roles answer 409 ROLE_LOCKED.
put.summary: Set a money limit of a role: 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000 (dollars) or null for No limit; stored in cents

put.description: Locked roles answer 409 ROLE_LOCKED ("Super Admin always has every permission"). Granting set.billing or pay.void needs a Super Admin. Publishes `rbac.changed` on the settings channel.
put.summary: Grant or revoke one permission on a role
